text:
Type: large open metal wall clock
Use: telling time, wall decoration; above a sofa, fireplace or table; living room, dining room
Style: industrial, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: distressed black metal frame, wood-look Roman numerals
Colors: black, warm natural wood brown
Shape: oversized round skeleton frame, open center, railing-like outer ring, large Roman numerals, spade hands, light and open
Feel: bold, vintage, rugged
Goes with: reclaimed wood, brick, black metal, neutral walls; industrial or farmhouse rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vintage Farmhouse Style Decorative Metal Wall Clock - 32 Inches, Black
product.description: Roman numerals crafted from wood and metal bring a rustic texture to this vintage-style clock. Black finished iron gives it a modern industrial touch. The result is a timekeeper that blends with any style room. 32" Diameter Hardwood, iron, rope Ready to hang, all hardware included
